summary: Water intake widget to log daily water consumption in ounces and display weekly consumption totals, with a $0.50 paywall/payment requirement to use the app.
architectural_notes: Introduce a paywall/payment flow requiring a one-time $0.50 payment before app use.

existing_features.title: Create a frontend water intake widget UI that lets the user record today’s water intake in ounces and view/edit their daily totals for the last 7 days.
Add a weekly consumption view that shows how much water the user consumed weekly, using the stored daily ounce totals.
Establish a coherent, distinctive visual theme for the app and apply it consistently across the water intake widget and weekly summary screens.
Implement the payment flow to unlock access for $0.50 and persist the unlocked state for the logged-in user.
Add a frontend paywall experience that blocks the hydration tracker UI until the user has paid $0.50, and provides clear English user-facing messaging for login, payment, and unlock status.

new_feature_requests.summary: Record/log daily water intake amounts in ounces.
Show weekly water consumption summary (e.g., totals by week).
Implement backend storage and APIs to record a user’s daily water intake amount in ounces and to retrieve weekly consumption summaries.
Add paid access: require users to pay $0.50 to use the app (paywall + payment processing).
Add backend support for paid access by tracking whether each caller (Principal) has unlocked the app and exposing an API to query the caller’s paid/unlocked status.
Enforce paid access on the backend by preventing unpaid users from recording water intake or fetching weekly summaries.

projectName: Water intake widget: log daily ounces and show weekly consumption
